testcase.name: security findings come from real scans, accepted package risks and settings, with counts and no score()
archive makes an application read-only and offline, restore makes it editable, admins see archived apps separately()
departments and teams - create, assign users and workspaces, delete only when empty, admin only, audited()
hosting cost - measured quantities times explicit prices, unknown without a price, never estimated()
